contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN CONSTA[---] ; R/ GLO[RI] EXER[CI]TVS

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (307-361), GLORIA EXERCITVS issue of 335-341, possibly a copy, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust diademed right, with prominent eye. Obverse inscription: DN CONSTA[---]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: GLO[RI] EXER[CI]TVS, letters appear heavily seriffed.
